rationale: Authoritative MNB register of licensed banks/payment/e-money institutions — mine once to build the A5 actor universe.
Hub page of sub-registers on mnb.hu; covered by monitoring the parent register, mine once for intermediary lists.
Supervisory newsroom continuously emits licence, sanction and senior-manager removal events.
Resolution decision register is a low-volume but high-signal organization-change stream.
Frozen legacy PSZÁF/MNB decision archive — harvest once for tenure/churn backfill, not ongoing.
BÉT issuer disclosure feed carries statutory 'vezető állású személyek' change notices with names and dates.
Statutory OAM archive of regulated information; broader issuer coverage than BÉT and stable document IDs.
Official company register is ground truth for officer changes at every HU bank, PSP and fintech; free tier public.
Only authoritative source of deleted officers with from/to dates, but paid/registered access must be cleared first.
Governing-body reference page about register products; documentation value only and URL verification failed.

Direct-announcement channel surfaces mergers, transformations and reorganisations of financial entities.
Annual filings give name-bearing officer cross-checks and average headcount, a direct jobs indicator.
Best person-level career-graph and change-alerting layer over the register, but commercial subscription and reuse terms need clearing.
Free public company profiles for low-volume officer verification and entity resolution by cégjegyzékszám.
Third-party register re-packager, redundant with OPTEN and the official register; keep only as a tie-break check.
Legal gazette database anchors leadership and governance changes at state-owned financial institutions.
English mirror of mnb.hu licensing pages; useful for terminology only, covered by the Hungarian parent.
Issuer-side statutory disclosure page; the pattern is enumerable across all HU banks and is fast per-institution.
Static statutes page — background evidence on board composition, not a recurring signal producer.
NGO tagged dossier, secondary and unverified URL; mine once for state-bank person leads at most.
Official gazette publishes appointments and restructuring of state-controlled financial bodies.
SZMSZ ministerial instructions define org structure and named leadership posts of state financial bodies; failed check is soft, re-verify.
Consolidated searchable instruction texts, easier to diff than gazette PDFs; liveness to be re-checked.
Official IM company-search entry point for exact legal names and current officers, keying Cégközlöny monitoring.
Procurement bulletin exposes HR, staffing, consultancy and IT tenders revealing org-change programmes at financial bodies.
Machine-readable procurement datasets and contract awards over the same corpus — strong structured ingest route.
Live e-procurement platform with CPV search and rich procedure documents describing target operating models and staffing.
